$comment: LS-18 (FIX-2) input half — the export case set. Authored AHEAD of docs/specs/LS-6.md: the spec does not exist yet, and this set is what gets fed through Gleef to anchor the spec's escaping rules and JSON shape. Once LS-6 §3 lands, THAT table becomes the authority and this file is its transcription (agent-guidelines §6); until then this file is the draft of record and the spec must be reconciled to it. Keys follow the LS-9 `dot` scheme and stay LS-9's — only output shape and escaping are Gleef-anchored.
$usage: Each entry maps to an ExtractedString (src/common/models.ts) as { key, nodeId, value } with drifted: false — `drifted` is not an export input. Array order IS document order, which the dedup survivor rule depends on; do not sort this file.
$notCovered: Very large exports (the issue's perf edge case) are a volume property, not a per-string one, and are exercised by a generated N-row set in the serializer tests, not by this table.

entries.exercises: no escaping in any format — the control row
double quote — escaped in all three, but by three different mechanisms
apostrophe — Android must escape or quote it; JSON and iOS leave it literal
both quote kinds in one value
backslash — doubled in all three formats
a LITERAL backslash-n (two characters) must survive as two characters and never become a newline — the inverse of row 7
a REAL newline — the inverse of row 6
a real tab
U+2028 — the character Figma writes for a soft line break inside a paragraph, so it reaches export from real files
bare ampersand — invalid raw in XML
angle brackets

entries.value: & is how you write an ampersand
entries.exercises: an entity-LOOKING literal: its & is still escaped, so Android correctly emits &amp; and round-trips. Emitting & here would silently corrupt the string
tag-looking content — escaped as text, NOT passed through as Android inline markup
leading @ — Android reserves it for resource references
leading ? — Android reserves it for theme attributes
i18next interpolation preserved verbatim — preserved, never generated
named i18next interpolation
iOS format specifier preserved
Android positional specifier preserved
brace-indexed placeholder preserved
a bare percent with no format specifier — Android convention would write %% here

a positional specifier AND a literal percent in one value. Escaping % to %% would rewrite the specifier and violate preserve-not-generate; leaving it bare diverges from Android convention. The spec must state the rule, not inherit it from a generic escaper
plural-LOOKING key carried as an ordinary key; Phase 1 does not interpret plural forms
the other half of the plural pair — still just two independent keys
RTL Arabic — emitted as UTF-8, not escaped to \u sequences
CJK
emoji outside the BMP — a surrogate pair that must not be split
ZWJ emoji sequence — must survive as one grapheme
precomposed é (U+00E9)
decomposed e + combining acute. Renders identically to row 29 but is a different string: no Unicode normalisation may be applied, and dedup must NOT merge the two
empty value — LS-9 excludes empty nodes, so the spec must state whether this is reachable at all
whitespace-only — Android trims unquoted values, so preserving this takes a deliberate rule
dedup group, member 1 of 3
dedup group, member 2 of 3
dedup group, member 3 of 3 — with the toggle on, one key survives and the rule picking it must be deterministic
differs from the group by a single trailing space — exact-value grouping must not merge it
a strict prefix collision with row 1's key. Unrepresentable in nested JSON — home.title cannot be both a string and an object — so this forces the leaf/branch rule
remaps to nav_item_2 for Android
ALSO remaps to nav_item_2 — the genuine collision that keyMap exists to record, and the reason keyMap is scoped to collisions rather than every remapped key
leading digit — a legal LS-9 key but invalid as an Android resource name, which must match [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*
forward slashes (JSON may or may not escape /), plus & and ? inside a URL rather than at the start
